modern: As for the animals which have no reason, and generally all things and objects, since you have reason and they have none, make use of them with a generous and open spirit. But towards human beings, since they have reason, behave in a social spirit. And on all occasions call on the gods, and do not trouble yourself about how long you will spend doing this; for even three hours spent like this are enough.
original: As to the animals which have no reason, and generally all things and objects, do thou, since thou hast reason and they have none, make use of them with a generous and liberal spirit. But towards human beings, as they have reason, behave in a social spirit. And on all occasions call on the gods, and do not perplex thyself about the length of time in which thou shalt do this; for even three hours so spent are sufficient.
